verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say it reviews the full codebase rather than just the diff (qodo-docs-22). They also describe cross-repository and service-level impact analysis and blast-radius risk classification (qodo-docs-14, qodo-docs-25), plus enforcement of coding standards and rules mined from PR history (qodo-docs-12, qodo-docs-13). missing for 10: the explicit full-codebase claim covers the PR summary rather than individual review comments, call-site analysis is not documented, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
